title: Stage Protection on Military Service Hold Extensions
content:
**Legal liaison note — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The stage protection of a service extension of a Military Service Hold depends on the held account's placement stage, as shown in its Placed Consumer Accounts record. The protection is added once to the days the service extension adds.

| Placement stage of the held account | Stage protection |
|---|---|
| Legal Review Placement | 30 calendar days (legal protection days), because a stay of any proceedings rests on the protection staying in place |
| Tertiary Placement | 15 calendar days (late-stage protection days) |
| Warehouse Placement | 15 calendar days (late-stage protection days) |
| Early-Out Placement, Primary Placement or Secondary Placement | Nothing |

**Points of reading.** The stage is that of the held account at the time of the extension. Tertiary and Warehouse Placement share the late-stage figure.

**Example (hypothetical).** A held account at Warehouse Placement: 15 calendar days are added on this ground. At Secondary Placement: nothing.
